_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Arrastra/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the middle of the front (north) row at ground level, under the hopper, where the draw gate is. Batch, by hand: no chute and no output. The player tips the charge into the hopper's mouth (loadCell, its top face) and draws the ground charge out at the gate in the curb (drawCell, its north face); the axle comes in high at the back (powerCell), the ppex water low at the back under it, into the pit (waterCell). Model only: no block or renderer reads it yet (#732). build: the stages in order. cells: the boxes of the whole machine built (the frame, every stage, the pipe), the turning parts' swept over the cycle. The only input is theta, the axle's angle. See the arrastra's README.

build._comment: Provisional (#733): the stages in the order they go on, each fitting its requires value once its materials are in; the frame (the head frame and the power shaft) is placed. The frame's recipe and each stage's items are open. The water pipe (pipecopper or pipelead, the metal supplied) needs the pit; the contents (charge, paste) are the batch's, not stages.
